title: Icon Style
slide_intent: Decide which corners should stay straight and which curves need enough breadth to read at small sizes. The difference can disappear when a drawing is reduced.
strategic_value: Instacart can carry the sharp and rounded details of its symbol into functional icons that remain recognizable in the interface.
demonstration: A symbol, map pin and flag appear enlarged on blue grids and again at small scale. Callouts connect their contours to the intended treatment of corners and rounds.
practical_value: Inspect an enlarged drawing and its reduced silhouette together. Keep small corners straight and reserve rounding for a feature large enough to survive the reduction.

content_islands.name: Construction brief
content_islands.spec: Set the title and shape guidance at left.

content_islands.name: Gridded examples
content_islands.spec: Arrange the symbol, pin and flag across three blue grids. Circle the contour details and attach concise blue callouts beneath them.

content_islands.name: Small-size checks
content_islands.spec: Align a reduced version under each enlarged specimen so the reader can compare the same geometry at both scales.
